note: Ordinary recto body page, single full-measure column: measure x 166-1169 px = 0.098-0.688 of the sheet (0.59 of sheet width), set toward the inner (left) edge with the wide outer margin on the right, where the folio tab sits. No figures, tables or boxes on this page - a solid run of body prose with five cyan section headings; all eleven A2 blocks matched to elements by position with no ambiguity. body_text_size_px = 21.0 px, measured cap-top (y=479) to baseline (y=500) on the first line of block 3 and confirmed on the last line of block 11 (1948-1969). Headings measure 23-24 px cap-to-baseline, hence size_rel 1.12. size_pt is given only on the headings: the PNG is a 200 dpi render (1700x2178 px = 8.5 x 10.89 in), so 23.5 px cap height is 8.5 pt, approx 12 pt type at a 0.70 cap-height ratio; body prose works out at approx 11 pt. Treat the heading size_pt as derived, not read off the page. Top furniture is two distinct bands and I have kept them apart: the pale-green page_header_band (#e0ebb6, y 0-0.082) and the grey strip that closes it (#d1d2d4, y 0.082-0.095). The allowed-role list has no name for that closing strip, so I used rule_bar; it is not the chapter-opening divider. The white rounded folio tab (rounded at the top corners only) straddles both bands in the OUTER margin and is reported as decorative_image, with the bold '7' on it as a separate page_number. The foot-of-page line '2024-25' is reported as running_header because the role list has no running-footer value; it is centred on the page and straddles the green bar's top edge by about 4 px, so I omitted its space_before rather than report a negative gap. space_before is likewise omitted on the running header, the folio tab and the page number, which overlay bands rather than follow them in the flow. text_block is reported literally as the brief defines it - top of the first line (y=297) to the baseline of the last (y=1969). page.fill 0.93 is therefore NOT that rectangle divided by itself: it is the printed depth (1969-297 = 1672 px) as a fraction of the depth available between the first-line top and the top of the green foot bar (2086-297 = 1789 px). The page is nearly full; the last line is a full-measure line and the paragraph runs on to p008, leaving about 111 px (0.051 of page height) of clear paper above the bar. I could not observe the designed bottom edge of the type frame, so I did not invent one. One artefact not reported as an element: a 40 x 2 px dark smudge at the extreme top-right corner (x 1660-1699, y 0-1), a scan/crop edge, not printed furniture. The grey diagonal 'NCERT / not to be republished' watermark (#e8e8e8) across the text area is also omitted - it is a stamp on the render, not page layout.
